name: swt-mirror-el-01
prompt: Bright, airy, awe-filled cinematic instrumental for a travel documentary short: shimmering plucked synth arpeggio and soft marimba pulse over warm strings and a gentle modern beat with soft kick. A clear, catchy melodic hook in the very first second, building to a wide, sunlit lift around the middle, then settling back to the opening phrase so it loops seamlessly. 100 BPM, major key, hopeful and wondrous. Clean and warm, leaves room for a narrator, no harsh highs, no vocals.

name: swt-sakura-el-01
prompt: Gentle, luminous springtime instrumental for a documentary short: plucked koto-like strings and felt piano over soft warm pads, light hand percussion and a soft modern pulse. Tender, hopeful, quietly amazed, like petals drifting in sunlight. A sweet melodic hook in the very first second, a warm emotional lift around the middle, then it returns to the opening phrase so it loops. 92 BPM, major key. Mellow, leaves room for a narrator, no harsh highs, no vocals.

name: swt-ice-el-01
prompt: Crystalline, bright and majestic instrumental for a nature documentary short about clear turquoise ice under blue skies: glassy bell and celesta motif, warm low strings, deep soft sub pulse and a gentle cinematic beat. Awe and wonder, never dark or scary. A memorable hook in the very first second, a big warm swell around the middle, then back to the opening motif so it loops. 96 BPM, major key. Clean, leaves room for a narrator, no harsh highs, no vocals.
